(assigned / total) : 0.0;\n\n  // Retrieve scheduled restart conflict limit (absolute conflict count)\n  const uint64_t base_limit = solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts;\n\n  // Adjust limit by multiplying by (1.0 + D^2)\n  const double trail_factor = 1.0 + (D * D);\n  const double adjusted_limit = (double)base_limit * trail_factor;\n\n  // Step 5: Trigger restart if current conflicts exceed adjusted limit * M\n  const double threshold = adjusted_limit * M;\n  \n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart algo: R=%.2f (%.2f/%.2f) M=%.2f D=%.2f \"\n                            \"base=%\" PRIu64 \" thresh=%.2f conflicts=%\" PRIu64,\n                            R, fast, slow, M, D,\n                            base_limit, threshold, CONFLICTS);\n\n  return ((double)CONFLICTS \u003e threshold);\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e"}]},"finishReason":"STOP","index":0}]},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
